flags.message: Decisive forward signal came from a companion docket, not this record: Berry v. United States, No. 25-7026, presents the same COA question, was CFR'd on 4/8/2026, has been distributed four times, and was relisted to 10/9/2026 in lockstep with this petition; Berry's 8/5/2026 supplemental brief asks the Court to grant Berry and hold Clark. The grant-side mass in this forecast is mostly a derivative GVR after a Berry decision. CourtListener's MCP server had the Berry docket shell but no entries or documents, so the docket and three filings were fetched from supremecourt.gov and the PDFs extracted locally; all pre-date this snapshot.
